CHAPTER.VERS: And Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way; and his disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.
And as he sat on the mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Tell us, when will these things be? And what [will be] the sign of your coming, and of the very end of the age?
For many will come in my name, saying, I am the Christ; and will lead many astray.
For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines and earthquakes in diverse places.
But all these things are the beginning of travail.
And brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child: and children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains:
let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out things that are in his house:
and let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
But woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse in those days!
for then will be great tribulation, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor will ever be.
And except those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved: but for the elect's sake those days will be shortened.
For there will arise false Christs, and false prophets, and will show great signs and wonders; so as to lead astray, if possible, even the elect.
But immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give her light, and the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
And then he will send forth the angels, and will gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
